idea-plugin.name: Sync SDKMAN
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps IntelliJ's Java SDK list lean and current, based on the JDKs installed with SDKMAN!:
  • exactly one SDK per managed Java version (default: all LTS versions, as published by foojay), always pointing to the newest installed patch release
  • other SDKs under SDKMAN are removed, also dead ones; open projects only move within the same Java version, and JDKs elsewhere or on your keep list stay
  • "Settings for New Projects" use the newest managed version
  • stable paths for tools outside the IDE: ~/.jdks-lts/21 always points to the newest installed Java 21 (optional), and Maven's toolchains.xml can be kept current (opt-in)
  • notifications about newer releases, installable via SDKMAN with one click
  • a warning when a project's .sdkmanrc pins an outdated Java version, with one-click updates to the latest release of the line or the latest LTS line
The plugin queries the foojay Disco API (LTS versions) and the SDKMAN API (available releases). Not affiliated with the SDKMAN! project.

action.description: Synchronize the Java SDK list with SDKMAN
